clue.text: Harrier, say, seen in spring stream

parts.note: to spring is to jump
a jet is a stream of liquid or gas

explanation.surface: A plane is spotted over a brook in springtime.
explanation.definitionFit: The Harrier is the famous British vertical take-off aircraft, an example of the type.

clue.text: Supports elevated places for stowing cargo

parts.note: up means raised or elevated
a ship's holds store its cargo

explanation.surface: Raised platforms hold a ship's freight.
explanation.definitionFit: To uphold is to support or maintain, as in upholding a decision.

clue.text: Song of starling starting in tree

indicators.note: in places the letter inside the tree

parts.note: a palm is a tree

indicators.note: starting takes the first letter of the bird's name

explanation.surface: A bird starts singing in a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: A psalm is a sacred song or hymn.

clue.text: The current recession

parts.note: looks like a remark on today's economic slump, but means a flow of water going back

explanation.definitionFit: The outgoing tide is literally a current that recedes.

clue.text: Rude and very Scottish sort of hut

parts.note: unco is a Scots word meaning very or extremely

indicators.note: a sort of hut is a version of it, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone describes a rough, distinctly Scottish shack.
explanation.definitionFit: Uncouth and rude are synonyms for coarse, ill-mannered behaviour.

clue.text: Relatives might make a scene about one

indicators.note: about means around, so one piece surrounds the other
might make suggests the letters could be formed into something else

parts.note: one is I as a Roman numeral

explanation.surface: Family members could cause a fuss over someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'might make' rearranges SCENE into NECES, and 'about' puts it round I.
explanation.definitionFit: Nieces are relatives, the daughters of one's siblings.

clue.text: Early defence in court

parts.note: old can mean early or ancient, as in the old days
a bailey is the defensive outer wall of a castle

explanation.surface: A prompt defence case is made in court.
explanation.walkthrough: The Old Bailey is London's Central Criminal Court.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the popular name of the Central Criminal Court in London.

clue.text: Report of big air crash

parts.note: seems to be about a news story of a plane disaster, but describes the loud sound of the sky crashing in a storm

explanation.definitionFit: Its loud crashing noise in the atmosphere is what follows lightning in a storm.

clue.text: Dispelled suspicion so that everyone might breathe more easily

definitions.text: Dispelled suspicion so that everyone might breathe more easily

parts.words: Dispelled suspicion so that everyone might breathe more easily
parts.note: the idiom for removing tension, read also as literally freshening the atmosphere

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means resolved tension or suspicion, from freshening a stuffy atmosphere.

clue.text: How odd a call to stop

indicators.note: odd here suggests the letters of how are set out strangely

explanation.surface: Someone remarks how strange a shout to halt sounds.
explanation.definitionFit: The interjection used to stop a horse, and by extension anyone, is a call to halt.

clue.text: Its author must love to write it

definitions.text: Its author must love to write it

parts.words: Its author must love to write it
parts.note: reads like a remark on a keen writer, but describes a letter that is written because the writer is in love

explanation.definitionFit: A love letter, from the French, is something only a lover writes.

clue.text: Milan University turning out graduates

indicators.note: turning out suggests the letters are turned about into a new order

explanation.surface: An Italian university produces its graduates.
explanation.definitionFit: Alumni are former students, the graduates of a school or college.

clue.text: City set within a river

indicators.note: within shows one piece placed inside the other

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Britain
to set something down is to lay it, past tense laid

explanation.surface: A town is built inside a river.
explanation.walkthrough: The Dee is a river in Scotland and another on the England-Wales border.
explanation.definitionFit: Adelaide is the capital of South Australia, a major city.

clue.text: In this form, two sides are perfectly matched

definitions.text: In this form, two sides are perfectly matched

parts.words: In this form, two sides are perfectly matched
parts.note: sounds like a sporting fixture between evenly matched teams, but describes a triangle shape with two equal sides

explanation.definitionFit: A triangle of this kind has two sides of equal length, a geometric description.

clue.text: Conspicuous chap, possibly a flasher

parts.note: signal as an adjective means notable or conspicuous
a chap is a man

explanation.surface: A man exposing himself is described as a conspicuous fellow.
explanation.definitionFit: A railway worker who operates signals might flash lights, so the definition is a joking example.

clue.text: Danger signal makes all but 50 prepare for battle

indicators.note: all but 50 means the word all without the fifty

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty
to arm is to equip oneself for fighting

explanation.surface: A warning tells nearly everyone to get ready to fight.
explanation.definitionFit: An alarm is a warning sound or signal of danger.

clue.text: Time to follow American custom

indicators.note: to follow places this piece after the other

parts.note: US is short for American, as in the US
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Eventually people adopt an American practice.
explanation.definitionFit: Usage means established practice or custom, as in common usage.

clue.text: Cat provided company in flood

indicators.note: in puts one piece inside the other

parts.note: a surge is a sudden rush or flood

explanation.surface: A cat with its firm is caught in a flood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cat' is the cat-o'-nine-tails, a whip; 'provided' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A whip used for flogging, like the cat-o'-nine-tails, is a type of lash.

clue.text: What a flypaper provides for insects?

definitions.text: What a flypaper provides for insects?

parts.words: What a flypaper provides for insects?
parts.note: literally a gluey edge on the paper, and figuratively the nasty fate awaiting the insects

explanation.definitionFit: This idiom means an unpleasant death, which is literally what a gluey strip brings flies.

clue.text: Fail to win in sporting contest: short-range shot needed

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: a cup is a sporting competition
to lose is to fail to win

explanation.surface: A team must get a short-range shot to avoid defeat in a tournament.
explanation.definitionFit: A photograph or film shot taken from very near the subject.

clue.text: One may retire in this close match

parts.note: nigh means near or close
a tie is a match or game in a cup competition

explanation.surface: A player might bow out during a tight game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retire' looks like leaving a sport, but means going to bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A garment worn to bed, which is where one retires at night.

clue.text: Two firms after gold mounting for decoration

indicators.note: after places these pieces following the gold
in a down clue, mounting means rising, so the word is read upwards

parts.note: or is gold in heraldry

indicators.note: two asks for the piece to be given twice

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm

explanation.surface: Two companies follow a gold mount for an ornament.
explanation.definitionFit: Rococo is an ornate decorative style of the 18th century.

clue.text: Under influence of drugs comes to a different view

indicators.note: a different view of these letters shows them rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone takes a new perspective while drugged.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in a coma or stupor can be caused by drugs, so the sense is deeply unconscious.

clue.text: Colour ring on compass

parts.note: a ring is round like the letter O
compass can mean scope or extent, a range

explanation.surface: A coloured ring is marked on a compass.
explanation.definitionFit: Orange is a colour between red and yellow.

clue.text: Hi-fi in Latin, I hear

definitions.meaning: the Latin verb form meaning I hear

explanation.definitionFit: The word means sound equipment, and in Latin it is the first-person verb meaning I hear.

clue.text: One may be uplifted by ship on the equator

parts.note: a tramp is a cargo ship with no fixed route
the equator is latitude zero, so the 0 line, read as O LINE

explanation.surface: Someone is raised up by a vessel crossing the equator.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' is a link word putting the pieces together.
explanation.definitionFit: A gymnast or child bouncing on this apparatus is lifted into the air by it.

clue.text: It may be kept or eaten

definitions.meaning: an appointment or engagement is something one keeps
the sweet fruit of a palm is eaten

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both an appointment that is kept and the fruit of the palm that is eaten.

clue.text: Received support when threatened

definitions.meaning: to pressure or intimidate someone, in the past tense

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both rested on for support and put pressure on someone.

clue.text: Work put forward, but not accepted

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work
to pose a question is to put it forward

explanation.surface: A proposal was submitted but rejected.
explanation.definitionFit: Something opposed is resisted rather than accepted.
